result.summary: 本文提出了 Transformer，这是第一个完全基于注意力机制、摒弃循环与卷积的序列转换模型 [S7.p1]。作者在 WMT 2014 英德与英法翻译任务上验证该模型，报告其在质量上更优、更易并行且训练时间显著更少 [abstract]。模型在英德任务上取得 28.4 BLEU，超过此前最佳结果（含集成模型）2 BLEU 以上；在英法任务上以 8 块 GPU 训练 3.5 天取得 41.8 的单模型 BLEU [abstract]。作者还将 Transformer 成功应用于英语成分句法分析，表明其可泛化到其他任务 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：主流序列转换模型依赖复杂的循环或卷积神经网络，其固有的顺序计算特性阻碍了训练样本内部的并行化，在序列较长时尤为关键 [S1.p2]。作者指出，注意力机制虽已被广泛使用，但几乎总是与循环网络结合使用 [S1.p3]。因此本文提出 Transformer，完全依靠注意力机制来建立输入与输出之间的全局依赖，从而允许显著更多的并行化 [S1.p4]。

evidence.quote: This inherently sequential nature precludes parallelization within training examples, which becomes critical at longer sequence lengths
In all but a few cases, however, such attention mechanisms are used in conjunction with a recurrent network.
In this work we propose the Transformer, a model architecture eschewing recurrence and instead relying entirely on an attention mechanism to draw global dependencies between input and output.
The Transformer allows for significantly more parallelization

method.text: Transformer 采用堆叠的自注意力层与逐位置全连接层构成编码器和解码器 [S3.p2]。其核心注意力函数将查询与一组键值对映射为输出，输出是值的加权和，权重由查询与对应键的兼容性函数计算 [S3.SS2.p1]。作者提出缩放点积注意力：计算查询与所有键的点积，各除以 √dk 后经 softmax 得到值的权重 [S3.SS2.SSS1.p1]。此外使用多头注意力，将查询、键、值线性投影 h 次后并行执行注意力，再拼接并投影 [S3.SS2.SSS2.p1]；本文采用 h=8 个并行注意力头，每个头 dk=dv=dmodel/h=64 [S3.SS2.SSS2.p5]。

evidence.quote: The Transformer follows this overall architecture using stacked self-attention and point-wise, fully connected layers for both the encoder and decoder
An attention function can be described as mapping a query and a set of key-value pairs to an output
We compute the dot products of the query with all keys, divide each by $\sqrt{d_{k}}$, and apply a softmax function to obtain the weights on the values.
we found it beneficial to linearly project the queries, keys and values $h$ times with different, learned linear projections
In this work we employ $h=8$ parallel attention layers, or heads.
For each of these we use $d_{k}=d_{v}=d_{\text{model}}/h=64$.

experiments.text: 训练数据为标准的 WMT 2014 英德数据集，约 450 万句对，使用字节对编码，共享源-目标词表约 37000 个 token；英法使用更大的 WMT 2014 英法数据集，含 3600 万句，词表为 32000 个 word-piece [S5.SS1.p1]。为评估各组件重要性，作者在英德翻译的开发集 newstest2013 上对基础模型做多种变体，使用束搜索但不做检查点平均 [S6.SS2.p1]。在英语成分句法分析上，作者仅在 Section 22 开发集上少量实验选择 dropout、学习率和束大小，其余参数保持英德基础翻译模型不变，推理时束大小为 21、α=0.3 [S6.SS3.p3]。

evidence.quote: We trained on the standard WMT 2014 English-German dataset consisting of about 4.5 million sentence pairs.
For English-French, we used the significantly larger WMT 2014 English-French dataset consisting of 36M sentences and split tokens into a 32000 word-piece vocabulary.
we varied our base model in different ways, measuring the change in performance on English-to-German translation on the development set, newstest2013
We used a beam size of $21$ and $\alpha=0.3$ for both WSJ only and the semi-supervised setting.

findings.text: 在 WMT 2014 英德翻译任务上，模型取得 28.4 BLEU，超过包括集成模型在内的现有最佳结果 2 BLEU 以上 [abstract]。在英法任务上，模型以 8 块 GPU 训练 3.5 天后取得 41.8 的单模型 BLEU，训练成本仅为文献中最佳模型的一小部分 [abstract]。在模型变体中，单头注意力比最佳设置差 0.9 BLEU，头数过多时质量也会下降 [S6.SS2.p2]。在英语成分句法分析上，尽管缺乏任务特定调参，模型表现仍优于此前所有报告模型，仅不及 Recurrent Neural Network Grammar [S6.SS3.p4]。此外，自注意力层以常数个顺序执行操作连接所有位置，而循环层需要 O(n) 个顺序操作 [S4.p4]。

evidence.quote: Our model achieves 28.4 BLEU on the WMT 2014 English-to-German translation task, improving over the existing best results, including ensembles, by over 2 BLEU.
our model establishes a new single-model state-of-the-art BLEU score of 41.8 after training for 3.5 days on eight GPUs
While single-head attention is 0.9 BLEU worse than the best setting, quality also drops off with too many heads.
yielding better results than all previously reported models with the exception of the Recurrent Neural Network Grammar
a self-attention layer connects all positions with a constant number of sequentially executed operations, whereas a recurrent layer requires $O(n)$ sequential operations

limitations.text: 作者指出，将任意两个位置关联所需的操作数在 Transformer 中降为常数，但代价是有效分辨率降低，原因是注意力加权位置被平均，这一影响通过多头注意力来抵消 [S2.p1]。作者还提出，为提升极长序列任务的计算性能，可将自注意力限制为只考虑以输出位置为中心、大小为 r 的邻域，并计划在未来工作中进一步研究该做法 [S4.p4]。

evidence.quote: In the Transformer this is reduced to a constant number of operations, albeit at the cost of reduced effective resolution due to averaging attention-weighted positions
To improve computational performance for tasks involving very long sequences, self-attention could be restricted to considering only a neighborhood of size $r$
We plan to investigate this approach further in future work.
